sections.heading: Why Seocho-gu Is a K-Drama Favorite
paragraphs: Seocho-gu sits on the south bank of the Han River, just west of Gangnam. It has riverside parks and lit-up bridges in the north, Korea's main court district in the middle, and the Seoul Arts Center and quiet stream-side cafe streets around Yangjae in the south.

In the public filming-location dataset from the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Seocho-gu has 295 records. Of those, 162 come from TV dramas, 83 from variety and food shows, 47 from K-Pop artists and 3 from films. By place type, 128 are parks and public spaces, 119 are restaurants and 20 are cafes.

Banpo Bridge and the Seoul Central District Court lead with 28 records each, followed by Some Sevit with 13. If a K-Drama character jogs across a bridge at night or leaves a courthouse after a divorce, it was probably filmed here.

sections.heading: Banpo Bridge, Some Sevit and Seorae Island: The Han River Night Scene
paragraphs: Banpo Bridge (서울특별시 서초구 반포동 반포대교) is probably the most filmed bridge in Korea. The KCISA records include Run On episode 6, where Ki Sun-gyeom stops jogging on the bridge to ask himself why he has never loved anyone, and Secret Garden's final episode 20, where Secretary Kim and Min Ah-young find a message in a bottle at the foot of the bridge on a snowy day. In Familiar Wife episode 2, Seo Woo-jin runs here, and in Forecasting Love and Weather episode 4, Jin Ha-kyung jogs across it.

The low deck below it is Jamsu Bridge (잠수교), which you can cross on foot. The dataset lists it as the spot where Yi-seo tosses a coin with her worries into the river in Itaewon Class, and as a photo location for NCT 127's Hello! #SEOUL photo book. The Moonlight Rainbow Fountain on Banpo Bridge usually runs from spring to autumn with several evening shows; check the Seoul Hangang Parks website for this year's schedule.

The three glass buildings floating next to the bridge are Some Sevit (서울특별시 서초구 올림픽대로 683). In Goblin episode 12, the confused Grim Reaper meets a fellow reaper here. In Misaeng episode 13, Jang Baek-ki asks Kang Hae-joon out for a drink at night, and in Hwayugi episode 5, Jin Seon-mi and Son Oh-gong come here after chasing away an evil spirit. The promenade is open all day and is free.

Banpo Hangang Park (서울특별시 서초구 신반포로11길 40) is listed as the filming location of BTS's RUN music video, and of the scene in Hotel del Luna where Oh Ji-ho and young Kim Kang-hoon meet the goddess Mago. A ten-minute walk west, Seorae Island (서울특별시 서초구 반포동 137-41) is a small island linked by three footbridges. In Bride of the Water God episode 3, Habaek and Yoon So-ah walk here and sit on the western corner to watch a large outdoor screen.
Getting there: Take Line 3, 7 or 9 to Express Bus Terminal Station and walk about 15 to 20 minutes north to the river, or take Line 9 to Sinbanpo Station.

sections.heading: Seocho-dong Court District: Where Legal Dramas Are Filmed
paragraphs: Korea's legal dramas keep coming back to the Seoul Court Complex (서울특별시 서초구 서초중앙로 157). The dataset says most of the courtroom exteriors in I Can Hear Your Voice were filmed here, and that Miss Hammurabi's judges Park Cha-oh-reum and Im Ba-reun are often seen in front of the east wing. In the final episode of Extraordinary Attorney Woo, Tae Su-mi holds a press conference in front of the building and withdraws as a minister nominee. Hyena, Your Honor, Innocent Defendant and The Penthouse 3 also filmed here.
The grounds are open on weekdays from 9 AM to 6 PM. It is a working court, so take photos only from public areas.

The nearest subway stop, Gyodae Station (Lines 2 and 3), is also a location. In Miss Hammurabi episode 1, the two judges first meet as adults at this station, and in episode 4 they help women handing out flyers outside Exit 11. In Judge vs. Judge, Lee Jung-joo gets off at Exit 10 on her way to work. From Exit 10 or 11, the court is about a 10-minute walk.

Near Gangnam Station (Line 2 / Shinbundang Line), two buildings on the Seocho side of the road come from My Love from the Star. GT Tower (서울특별시 서초구 서초대로 411) is where Cheon Song-yi lives in episode 5, and Boutique Monaco (서울특별시 서초구 서초대로 397) is the rooftop where Do Min-joon threatens Lee Jae-kyung in episode 14. Both are private buildings, so view them from the street.

sections.heading: Seoul Arts Center and Yangjae: Concerts, Forest and Cafe Streets
paragraphs: The Seoul Arts Center (서울특별시 서초구 남부순환로 2406) is Korea's biggest performing arts complex. In Do You Like Brahms? episode 1, its concert hall is the venue for the university's 60th-anniversary concert where Park Joon-young plays piano. In The King: Eternal Monarch episode 1, Lee Lim arrives in 1994 in front of the art museum here. The outdoor plaza is open all day. Take Line 3 to Nambu Bus Terminal Station, Exit 5, and walk about 10 minutes.

Yangjae Citizen's Forest Station (서울특별시 서초구 매헌로 116) on the Shinbundang Line appears in Start-Up episode 2, when Seo Dal-mi gets off here. The dataset also lists it as the station from Squid Game where the salesman asks, "Would you like to play a game with me?" and starts the ddakji game. The large, shady Yangjae Citizen's Forest is next to the station.
A short taxi ride away, Seocho Culture & Arts Park (서초문화예술공원, 서울특별시 서초구 바우뫼로12길 40) is where Dong-baek and Yong-sik share a kiss in the final episode of When the Camellia Blooms.

Along the Yangjae stream, Cafe Lily Blanc (카페 릴리블랑, 서울특별시 서초구 양재천로19길 52) is the cafe used in episodes 1, 3 and 9 of Should We Kiss First and in My Golden Life. It is open weekdays 8 AM to 10 PM and Saturdays 10 AM to 10 PM, and closed Sundays. Around the corner, Miss Yoon (미쓰윤, 서울특별시 서초구 양재천로17길 3) is where TWICE shot part of their YES or YES album, and it also appears in Hwayugi episode 1. It is open weekdays only, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: TV-Famous Seocho Restaurants
paragraphs: Yeongdong Jokbal (영동족발 본점, 서울특별시 서초구 남부순환로358길 8) near Yangjae Station has appeared on Wednesday Food Talk and is listed as a favorite of Kang Daniel. Close by, Gangchon Wonjo Jjukkumi (강촌원조쭈꾸미본점, 서울특별시 서초구 남부순환로350길 36) has been on Delicious Guys and several evening TV shows for its spicy stir-fried baby octopus. It is open daily from 11 AM to 11:30 PM.

For a lighter meal, Odaesan Sanchae (오대산 산채전문점, 서울특별시 서초구 남부순환로 2640-11 1층) serves a mountain-vegetable set meal with about 30 side dishes and nameul bibimbap. It is open daily from 10 AM to 10 PM. Les Prémices (레프레미스, 서울특별시 서초구 남부순환로337길 36) is the macaron shop BLACKPINK's Rosé praised on Wednesday Food Talk. It is closed on Mondays.

In Jamwon-dong, near Sinsa Station (Line 3), Pro Ganjang Gejang (프로간장게장, 서울특별시 서초구 강남대로97길 9) is famous for soy-marinated raw crab, with signed visits from Super Junior's Heechul, TWICE's Momo and Davichi. Jamwon Tteokbokki (잠원떡볶이, 서울특별시 서초구 잠원로4길 45) is a small snack shop loved by Dynamic Duo's Gaeko and Super Junior's Kyuhyun. Hours change, so check Naver Map before you go.

sections.heading: Half-Day Seocho-gu K-Spot Route
paragraphs: Start in the early afternoon at Nambu Bus Terminal Station and walk to the Seoul Arts Center. Ride Line 3 one stop to Yangjae Station for a late lunch at Odaesan Sanchae or Yeongdong Jokbal, then stroll the Yangjaecheon cafe street to Cafe Lily Blanc.

Next, take Line 3 north to Gyodae Station for the court district from Miss Hammurabi and Extraordinary Attorney Woo, then continue to Express Bus Terminal Station. Walk to the river before sunset, cross Jamsu Bridge on foot, see Some Sevit light up and, in fountain season, watch the Moonlight Rainbow Fountain from Banpo Hangang Park.

With more time, add Gangnam Station for My Love from the Star or Yangjae Citizen's Forest Station for Squid Game. Show taxi drivers the Korean address for each stop; most rides inside Seocho-gu take 10 to 20 minutes.

sections.heading: Why Incheon's Jung-gu Is a K-Drama Favorite
paragraphs: Most visitors pass through Incheon's Jung-gu without knowing it. The district covers both the old port neighborhood around Incheon Station and Yeongjong Island, home to Incheon International Airport. That mix of 19th-century treaty-port streets, Chinatown, a seaside promenade, a giant airport and glossy resort hotels gives drama crews almost every kind of backdrop within one district.

In the public filming-location dataset from the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Incheon's Jung-gu has 335 records. Of those, 225 come from TV dramas, 89 from variety and food shows, 20 from K-Pop artists and one from a film. By place type, 174 are parks and public spaces, 87 are restaurants, 45 are hotels and 28 are cafes.

The airport alone has 86 records, Paradise City resort has 24 and Grand Hyatt Incheon has 17. For a walking trip, though, the best part is the old port: Wolmi Theme Park (14 records), Incheon Art Platform (12) and Jayu Park are all within about 15 minutes of Incheon Station, the last stop on Seoul Subway Line 1.

sections.heading: Chinatown and Songwol-dong: Jajangmyeon and Fairy-Tale Murals
paragraphs: Step out of Incheon Station and the red main gate of Chinatown is right across the road. The KCISA records list Chinatown-ro 44beon-gil (인천광역시 중구 차이나타운로44번길) as the street where Wang Joo-hyun takes a selfie at the entrance in Witch Hunter (Night After Night) episode 13, and as the gang territory of the fictional Haewol-dong in Tell Me What You Saw episodes 8, 9 and 11.

Chinatown is also where jajangmyeon, the black-bean noodle dish every K-Drama character orders on moving day, became a Korean classic. The Jajangmyeon Museum (짜장면박물관, 인천광역시 중구 차이나타운로 56-14) is housed in the old Gonghwachun restaurant building. In A Korean Odyssey, the grandson of the general store owner sets up an unusual street stall in front of it. The dataset lists it as open Tuesday to Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM and closed Mondays.

A five-minute walk north of Chinatown, Songwol-dong's alleys are painted with scenes from fairy tales like The Wizard of Oz and Alice in Wonderland. It is mostly a photo stop, but the dataset includes Cafe Oz (카페오즈, 인천광역시 중구 동화마을길 21-19), featured on three TV shows for its jajang bingsu, a shaved-ice dessert styled like black-bean noodles. It is open daily from 11:30 AM to 6:30 PM.

sections.heading: Jayu Park and Incheon Art Platform: Goblin's Port Town
paragraphs: Jayu Park (Freedom Park), Korea's first Western-style park, sits on a hill above Chinatown at 인천광역시 중구 송학동1가 1-1. The KCISA dataset says Kim Shin and Ji Eun-tak come here for a walk in Goblin episode 8, and another record calls it the place where Eun-tak blows out a flame to summon Kim Shin. In the final episode 12 of Business Proposal, Kang Tae-moo proposes to Shin Ha-ri on a park path. Love Alarm episode 1 shows Lee Hye-young and Hwang Sun-oh cycling past on the way to school, and School 2021 episode 14 and Model Detective also filmed here. The park is open all day. Walk up the stairs behind Chinatown, about 15 minutes from Incheon Station, for views over the harbor.

Down the hill toward the port, Incheon Art Platform (인천아트플랫폼, 인천광역시 중구 제물량로218번길 3) is a cluster of red-brick warehouses turned into studios and galleries. In Goblin episode 14, Kim Shin walks here after meeting Eun-tak at the Hanmi Bookstore, which is a short taxi ride away in Dong-gu. It also played the Kirin Art School in Dream High, and in Business Proposal episode 2 Jin Young-seo and Kang Tae-moo meet here to talk. Monthly Magazine Home, Doom at Your Service and Switch also filmed here. The dataset lists it as open Tuesday to Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM and closed Mondays, but the outdoor plaza is easy to walk through anytime.

sections.heading: Wolmido: Seaside Rides, Lighthouse and Squid Game
paragraphs: Wolmido is a small former island west of Incheon Station, linked by the elevated Wolmi Sea Train. Wolmi Theme Park (인천광역시 중구 월미문화로 81) has 14 records. In Touch Your Heart episode 11, Kwon Jung-rok takes Oh Yoon-seo here on a date and promises to protect her no matter what. In Let's Fight Ghost episodes 7 and 8, Bong-pal finally keeps his promise to take Hyun-ji to an amusement park. The dataset also notes Rain's and Jay Park's Gang music videos and a TWICE ride on the Disco Pang Pang. It is open from 10 AM to 9 PM on weekdays and until 11 PM on weekends.
Next door, My Land (인천광역시 중구 월미로234번길 7) is where gangster Jang Deok-su meets an acquaintance after the games stop in Squid Game, and Extracurricular episodes 5 and 6 also filmed key scenes here.

The seaside promenade, Wolmi Culture Street (인천광역시 중구 북성동1가 98-57), is open all day. In Stove League episode 13, Baek Seung-soo asks Im Dong-gyu to rejoin the Dreams at the Wolmido lighthouse at the end of the street. In Twenty-Five Twenty-One episode 10, Moon Ji-woong hangs out with breakdancers here, and in Lawless Lawyer episode 4 Ha Jae-yi and Bong Sang-pil walk along the water. Be Melodramatic and Switch also filmed here. Come at sunset, when the sky over the Yellow Sea turns orange.

sections.heading: Yeongjong Island: The Airport and Resort Hotels
paragraphs: Incheon International Airport (인천국제공항, 인천광역시 중구 공항로 272) is the most filmed single place in this district. The dataset lists scenes from SKY Castle episode 11, when Cha Se-ri arrives from the United States, Goong episode 2, when Prince Lee Yul lands from England, and What's Wrong with Secretary Kim episode 13 in Terminal 2. If you fly into Korea, you have already seen it.

From Terminal 1, a free shuttle runs to Paradise City (파라다이스시티, 인천광역시 중구 영종해안남로321번길 186), the resort that played Lee Gon's hotel in The King: Eternal Monarch, the Royal Pacific hotel in Hotel del Luna episode 1 and a Granada hotel in Memories of the Alhambra. Grand Hyatt Incheon (인천광역시 중구 영종해안남로321번길 208) next door appears in Itaewon Class episode 10, Vincenzo episode 14 and Mine. If you have a long layover, both are easy to visit.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: TV-Famous Incheon Restaurants
paragraphs: England Donkkaseu (잉글랜드돈까스, 인천광역시 중구 우현로90번길 7 혜성빌딩 2층) is an old-style Western restaurant. In Reply 1988, Jung-hwan's whole family eats out here, and in Navillera episode 6 Shim Deok-chul and Choi Hae-nam celebrate their wedding anniversary. It is open Tuesday to Sunday from 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM and closed Mondays.

In Chinatown, Shinseung Banjeom (신승반점, 인천광역시 중구 차이나타운로44번길 31-3) and Mandabok (만다복, 인천광역시 중구 차이나타운로 36) both appeared on Wednesday Food Talk for their jajangmyeon, and both are listed as open daily from 11 AM to 9 PM. For a snack, Incheondang (인천당, 인천광역시 중구 참외전로 138) sells traditional Korean sweets and has been on five TV shows. Near Sinpo Market, Myeongwol-jip (명월집, 인천광역시 중구 신포로23번길 41) serves kimchi-jjigae set meals and is closed on Sundays. Ilgwang Jeongu Lighthouse (일광전구 라이트하우스, 인천광역시 중구 참외전로174번길 8-1), a cafe in an old light-bulb factory, appears in It's Okay to Not Be Okay episode 1 and Kkondae Intern. Check Naver Map for current hours before you go.

sections.heading: Half-Day and One-Day Incheon Jung-gu K-Spot Routes
paragraphs: For a half day, take Line 1 or the Suin-Bundang Line to Incheon Station, about 60 to 70 minutes from Seoul Station. Walk through the Chinatown gate, eat jajangmyeon for an early lunch, visit the Jajangmyeon Museum and the Songwol-dong murals, then climb to Jayu Park for the Goblin and Business Proposal walk. Head downhill to Incheon Art Platform and finish with tonkatsu at England Donkkaseu.

For a full day, take the Wolmi Sea Train from Incheon Station in the afternoon. Ride the rides at Wolmi Theme Park, then walk Wolmi Culture Street to the lighthouse from Stove League for sunset. If you are flying out, save Yeongjong Island for your last day and stop at Paradise City before your flight.
Show taxi drivers the Korean address for each stop. A taxi from Incheon Station to Wolmido takes about 10 minutes, and the airport is 40 to 50 minutes away by car or AREX.

sections.heading: Why Goyang and Ilsan Keep Showing Up in K-Dramas
paragraphs: Goyang is the big city just northwest of Seoul, and most visitors know its newer half, Ilsan. If you have watched Korean TV for a few years, you have almost certainly seen it. Two of Korea's largest broadcasters run production centers here, MBC Dream Center and SBS Ilsan Production Center, so crews do not have to travel far when a script calls for a lakeside walk, a wide plaza or a quiet restaurant room. Ilsan was planned in the early 1990s, which gives it broad tree-lined streets, a huge man-made lake and modern buildings that can stand in for almost anywhere.

In the public filming-location dataset from the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Goyang-si has 516 records. Of those, 387 come from TV dramas, 91 from variety and food shows, 35 from K-Pop artists and three from films. By place type, 229 are parks and public spaces and 210 are restaurants, with 39 cafes. Most entries sit in Ilsandong-gu (about 340), followed by Deogyang-gu (95) and Ilsanseo-gu (about 80).

The single most filmed place is Ilsan Lake Park with 49 records. Asoan, a Korean restaurant a short walk away, has 45, and Ilsan Culture Square has 17. That makes a Goyang trip easy to plan: one subway station, Jeongbalsan on Line 3, puts you within walking distance of all three.

sections.heading: Ilsan Lake Park: The Metasequoia Path and Lakeside Dates
paragraphs: Ilsan Lake Park, at 경기도 고양시 일산동구 호수로 731, wraps around a man-made lake with walking and cycling paths, a rose garden and a well-known metasequoia lane. The KCISA records read like a list of K-Drama classics. In The Heirs episode 11, Cha Eun-sang and Kim Tan walk the metasequoia path among autumn leaves the morning after a camping trip. In Encounter (also known as Boyfriend) episode 11, Cha Soo-hyun and Kim Jin-hyuk head to the same lane on a date, where he shows her how to take photos and later gives her a couple ring. In Touch Your Heart episode 7, Kwon Jung-rok hands Oh Yoon-seo a handwritten letter on the path, and Hyde Jekyll, Me episode 12 has Hyun Bin and Han Ji-min walking there too.

The list keeps going. In My Love from the Star episode 17, Cheon Song-yi and Do Min-joon argue in the park, and in episode 21 Song-yi is shooting a drama at the park's waterfall plaza. In Tale of the Nine-Tailed episode 1, Lee Yeon sits on a bench and watches families pass. In Yumi's Cells, Kim Yu-mi sets up a meeting by the fountain in the rose garden during the Goyang flower festival, and in Yumi's Cells 2 episode 1 she jogs along the lake. A Gentleman's Dignity and Hotel del Luna also filmed here.
The dataset lists the park as open daily from 8 AM to 8 PM. From Jeongbalsan Station (Line 3), walk about 10 minutes toward the lake. Late October and early November bring the best metasequoia color.

sections.heading: Jeongbalsan Station Area: Asoan, Culture Square and La Festa
paragraphs: Asoan, at 경기도 고양시 일산동구 정발산로 128, is the place K-Drama writers send powerful people to make secret deals. It has 45 records in the dataset. In SKY Castle episode 10, Kang Joon-sang meets his neighbor Cha Min-hyuk here to talk about the children's education. In The World of the Married episodes 9 and 10, Yeo Byung-gyu meets Dr. Kim Yoon-ki here, and in Itaewon Class episode 14 Kang Min-jung and Jo Yi-seo meet an investor. The film Inside Men used it too. The dataset lists it as open daily from 11:30 AM to 9:30 PM.

Right next to Jeongbalsan Station, Ilsan Culture Square (경기도 고양시 일산동구 중앙로 1271-4) is an open plaza with benches that is open all day. In While You Were Sleeping episode 3, Nam Hong-joo walks through it and tells a little girl who lost her balloon that a tall man will soon help her. In Start-Up, Seo Dal-mi sits on a bench here and calls her father after a fight with her sister. The Heirs also filmed a snowy walk here.

Across the street, La Festa (경기도 고양시 일산동구 중앙로 1305-56) is a car-free shopping street with an arched entrance. The KCISA records say the whole cast of Dream High filmed the flash mob in the final episode here. It also appears in How to Hate You episode 1. Shop hours vary by store.

sections.heading: Ilsanseo-gu: KINTEX, One Mount and Aqua Planet
paragraphs: KINTEX, Korea's largest exhibition center at 경기도 고양시 일산서구 킨텍스로 217-60, is a favorite airport double. The KCISA dataset says Squid Game uses it in the final episode 9, when Gi-hun heads to the airport for Los Angeles. In Now, We Are Breaking Up episode 15, it stands in for Incheon Airport as Yoon Jae-kook leaves and Ha Young-eun comes to say goodbye. Opening times depend on the exhibition schedule. Take the GTX-A express to Kintex Station, or Line 3 to Daehwa Station and walk or take a short bus ride.

A few minutes' walk from KINTEX, One Mount (원마운트, 경기도 고양시 일산서구 한류월드로 300) is a shopping and leisure complex with a snow park. In Love Alarm episode 1, Kim Jo-jo skates there with her two best friends, and in episode 4 she returns for a skating date with Hwang Sun-oh. The dataset also notes that Gain appears here in PSY's Gentleman music video, and Pinocchio episodes 7 and 8 filmed the brothers' reunion here.

Next door, Aqua Planet Ilsan (아쿠아플라넷 일산, 경기도 고양시 일산서구 한류월드로 282) is listed as open daily from 10 AM to 6 PM. In Move to Heaven episode 1, Han Geu-ru visits the aquarium, where his friend Yoon Na-mu works. Kill Me, Heal Me and The Devil Judge also filmed here, and it makes a good rainy-day stop.

sections.heading: Deogyang-gu: Haengjusanseong Fortress and the Han River
paragraphs: Goyang's older half, Deogyang-gu, sits along the Han River. Haengjusanseong (행주산성), the hilltop fortress where Joseon forces won a famous battle in 1593, is now a park with river views. The KCISA dataset lists it at 경기도 고양시 덕양구 행주외동 140-8. In The Veil episode 6, Han Ji-hyuk and Lin Wei come to a memorial stone in the park. In Sell Your Haunted House episode 2, Oh In-beom and Heo Ji-cheol drink morning coffee here at sunrise, and A Piece of Your Mind also filmed here. Take a taxi from Hwajeong Station (Line 3), about 15 minutes, or check KakaoMap for local buses.

Below the fortress, the riverside road has more drama spots. Opera Divas (오페라 디바스, 경기도 고양시 덕양구 행주산성로 141) is where Hong Dae-young has lunch with his twins in 18 Again episode 1, and Ha Young-eun turns down a magazine interview there in Now, We Are Breaking Up episode 13. The dataset adds that Loco and Hwasa's song Don't Give It to Me was born here. The Ts Coffee Factory (더츠커피팩토리, 경기도 고양시 덕양구 행주산성로120번길 8) appears in Signal, Cinderella and Four Knights and Perfect Wife.

Further inland, the Wondang horse ranch (경기도 고양시 덕양구 서삼릉길 233-112) has open pastures and a tree-lined road. It appears in Goong episode 16, That Winter, the Wind Blows episode 5, The World of the Married episode 15 and Secret Garden episode 7, where Kim Joo-won and Gil Ra-im drive down the road. The dataset lists it as open Wednesday to Sunday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed Mondays and Tuesdays. It is next to the Seosamneung royal tombs, so take a taxi from Samsong Station (Line 3).

sections.heading: Where to Eat: Drama and TV-Famous Goyang Restaurants
paragraphs: Near Haengjusanseong, Gananan Guksu (가나안국수, 경기도 고양시 덕양구 행주로15번길 16) is known for chilled chogye noodles and has been featured on four food shows, including 2TV Saengsaeng Information. The dataset lists it as open daily from 9 AM to 9 PM. Neunggok Halmeoni Bugeotang (능곡할머니북어탕, 경기도 고양시 덕양구 토당로 66-15) serves dried pollack soup and appeared on Amazing Saturday and Delicious Guys. It is open Tuesday to Sunday from 7 AM to 3 PM, so go for breakfast or an early lunch.

In Ilsan, Pino (경기도 고양시 일산동구 애니골길 72) on the Annigol cafe street has 20 drama records, including A Gentleman's Dignity, Jealousy Incarnate episode 18, Itaewon Class episode 6 and Yumi's Cells 2 episode 6. Nearby Baengma Hwasarang (백마 화사랑, 경기도 고양시 일산동구 애니골길 14-14) is the cafe from Another Miss Oh and Signal episode 4. Shilla Myeonok (신라면옥 본점, 경기도 고양시 일산동구 탄중로431번길 15), a cold-noodle restaurant that appears in Stranger, is closed on Mondays and Thursdays. Always check current hours on Naver Map before you go.

sections.heading: Half-Day and One-Day Goyang K-Spot Routes
paragraphs: For a half day, take Line 3 to Jeongbalsan Station. Start at Ilsan Culture Square and La Festa, then walk to Ilsan Lake Park and follow the shore to the metasequoia path and the rose garden. Finish with a late lunch at Asoan,.

For a full day, add Ilsanseo-gu in the afternoon: take a bus or taxi to One Mount and Aqua Planet, then walk to KINTEX for the "airport" building from Squid Game. If you prefer history and river views, spend the morning at Haengjusanseong with chogye noodles at Gananan Guksu instead, then ride Line 3 north to Jeongbalsan for the lake park at sunset.
Show your taxi driver the Korean address for each stop. Allow 25 to 40 minutes by taxi between Haengjusanseong and Ilsan, and about 10 minutes between Jeongbalsan and KINTEX.

sections.heading: Why Paju Is the K-Drama Day Trip North of Seoul
paragraphs: When a K-Drama needs a sleek publishing house, a gallery cafe with concrete walls, a European-style garden or a quiet temple at dusk, the location team very often drives north out of Seoul to Paju. The city sits on the Han and Imjin rivers right below the inter-Korean border, about an hour from central Seoul, and it packs a surprising mix of scenery into one place: Paju Book City, a planned town of architect-designed publishing offices; Heyri Art Village, a hillside of galleries, studios and cafes; and green escapes such as Byeokchoji Arboretum and the Imjingak peace park.

In the public filming-location dataset published by the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Paju-si has 533 records. Of those, 417 come from TV dramas, 79 from variety and food shows, 33 from K-Pop artists and four from films. By place type, 305 are parks, galleries and other public spaces, 119 are restaurants and 92 are cafes. That makes Paju a district for strolling between buildings and gardens, then stopping for coffee in a place you have already seen on screen.

The single most filmed place in the city is White Block, a gallery and cafe in Heyri, with 44 records. A rental filming studio in Tanhyeon-myeon has 40, the Gyeonggi English Village has 33, Farmers Table restaurant in Heyri has 32, the Forest of Wisdom library has 31 and Byeokchoji Arboretum has 29.

sections.heading: Paju Book City: Libraries, Publishers and Gallery Cafes
paragraphs: The Forest of Wisdom, at 경기도 파주시 회동길 145, is a library with bookshelves that rise to the ceiling, and it is open daily from 10 AM to 8 PM. It is one of the most recognizable sets in modern K-Drama. According to the KCISA records, in What's Wrong with Secretary Kim episode 4 Lee Young-joon and Kim Mi-so wander the library during a blackout, and he lights the shelves with his phone so she can read her favorite book. She Was Pretty, Hotel del Luna, The King: Eternal Monarch, The World of the Married, Chicago Typewriter and My Unfamiliar Family also filmed here.

Walk south along Hoedong-gil and you will recognize more buildings. Tteuindol Publishing (뜨인돌출판사, 경기도 파주시 회동길 337-9), with its cross-shaped glass staircase, appears in Search: WWW episode 5, It's Okay, That's Love and It's Okay to Not Be Okay. Mediterium (메디테리움, 경기도 파주시 회동길 338) becomes the Search Korea office in Stranger 2 and the Julie Books building in Yumi's Cells 2. Art Gallery Cafe (아트갤러리카페, 경기도 파주시 회동길 445-2) is where Kim Mi-so meets Young-joon's mother in Secretary Kim episode 3, and Cafe Paper and Tree (카페 종이와 나무, 경기도 파주시 회동길 445-1) shows up in Romance Is a Bonus Book episode 11 and Business Proposal.

sections.heading: Heyri Art Village: Galleries, Cafes and Drama Restaurants
paragraphs: White Block, at 경기도 파주시 탄현면 헤이리마을길 72, is a white gallery building with a large cafe facing a pond. The dataset lists the cafe as open 10:30 AM to 7 PM on weekdays and until 9 PM on weekends. In 18 Again episode 5, Choi Il-kwon meets Jung Da-jung here while Hong Dae-young watches from a distance, and in More Than Friends episode 8, Lee-soo visits his mother's exhibition in the gallery. On the Way to the Airport, Military Prosecutor Doberman, Legend of the Blue Sea, Misty and 30 But 17 also filmed here.

This cafe and restaurant building at 경기도 파주시 탄현면 헤이리마을길 47 is where Park Do-kyung and Oh Hae-young first meet in Another Miss Oh episode 1, and where Kim Mi-so and Lee Young-joon come for comfort food in Secretary Kim episode 12. Man to Man and My Secret Hotel also used it. It is open daily from 11 AM to 9 PM.
Heyri itself is free to walk, and many of the small museums and galleries charge their own entry. Note that a number of Heyri businesses close on Mondays.

sections.heading: Byeokchoji Arboretum and the English Village
paragraphs: Byeokchoji, at 경기도 파주시 광탄면 부흥로 242, is a landscaped arboretum with a lotus pond, a willow-lined lake and formal European gardens. The dataset lists it as open daily from 9 AM to 5:30 PM. This is the garden where Kang Dan-i and Cha Eun-ho walk and kiss in the final scene of Romance Is a Bonus Book, and where Hong Ji-hong proposes to Yoo Hye-jung in Doctors episode 20. In The Mask, Choi Min-woo brings Byun Ji-sook here to listen to the wind and birds. In Park Chan-wook's film The Handmaiden, the count and Sook-hee argue over their secret deal in these gardens.

K-Pop fans will recognize it too: the KCISA dataset lists Red Velvet's Psycho music video, VIXX, Apink, B1A4 and BTOB music videos, a (G)I-DLE teaser, and a visit Jennie of BLACKPINK posted on Instagram. There is no train station nearby, so take a taxi from Geumchon or Munsan Station on the Gyeongui-Jungang Line.

This mock European town at 경기도 파주시 탄현면 얼음실로 40 is a favorite stand-in for foreign cities. In Search: WWW, Cha Hyun and Seol Ji-hwan watch the sunrise from its parking lot, and in More Than Friends episode 14 it doubles as an American city where Lee-soo calls Woo-yeon at night. The dataset also lists TWICE's Cheer Up music video, EXO's Miracles in December and Super Junior's Magic. It is about ten minutes by taxi from Heyri.

sections.heading: Yakcheonsa Temple, Unjeong Lake Park and Imjingak
paragraphs: Yakcheonsa (약천사), at 경기도 파주시 교하로681번길 118, is a small hillside temple near the Unjeong new town. In My Liberation Notes episode 8, Mr. Gu and Yeom Mi-jeong come here in the evening and watch a rainbow appear in front of them. Her Private Life, Melting Me Softly and My ID Is Gangnam Beauty also filmed here. Nearby, Unjeong Lake Park (운정호수공원, 경기도 파주시 경의로 1151) is open 24 hours and appears in The Devil Judge and How to Hate You.

Further north, Imjingak (임진각, 경기도 파주시 문산읍 임진각로 164) and the Peace Nuri park beside it sit just south of the Civilian Control Line. The dataset says Woo Seo-ri and Gong Woo-jin share their first kiss at Imjingak Peace Nuri in 30 But 17, and the film 1987 opens with Kim Yoon-seok's character performing an ancestral rite here. Take a taxi from Munsan Station, the end of the Gyeongui-Jungang Line commuter service.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: Drama-Famous Paju Restaurants
paragraphs: Farmers Table (파머스테이블, 경기도 파주시 탄현면 헤이리마을길 59-77) in Heyri has 32 drama records. The Hong family has dinner here in 18 Again episode 18, and Kim Mi-so and Lee Sung-yeon eat here in Secretary Kim episode 5. The dataset lists it as closed on Mondays. Also in Heyri, Mokushura (모쿠슈라, 경기도 파주시 탄현면 헤이리마을길 54) is where Yumi takes Woo-gi for lunch in Yumi's Cells episode 2, and it appears in Our Beloved Summer and Business Proposal. It opens daily from 10:30 AM to 9:30 PM.

For a cheaper bowl, Yonggung Kalguksu (용궁칼국수, 경기도 파주시 탄현면 새오리로 59-52) serves seafood knife-cut noodles. Vincenzo and Hong Cha-young have lunch here with a prosecutor in Vincenzo episode 14, and the dataset notes a signed autograph from Sunny of Girls' Generation from a Running Man shoot. Always confirm current hours on Naver Map before you go, since some places may have changed since the data was recorded.

sections.heading: Half-Day and One-Day Paju K-Spot Routes
paragraphs: Take bus 2200 from Hapjeong Station in Seoul to Paju Book City and start at the Forest of Wisdom when it opens. Walk Hoedong-gil past the publishers and stop for coffee at Art Gallery Cafe, then ride the same bus line a few stops north to Heyri. Have lunch at Farmers Table or Mokushura, then finish at White Block and Adamas 253.

A full Paju day works best by taxi or rental car, because the spots are spread out. Begin at Byeokchoji Arboretum in the morning when the light is soft, continue north to Imjingak for the border views, then come back south to Heyri for a late lunch and the gallery cafes. If you still have time, end at Yakcheonsa or Unjeong Lake Park at sunset.
Show your taxi driver the Korean address for each stop. Paju is large, so allow 20 to 40 minutes between the gardens, Heyri and Imjingak.

sections.heading: Why Yeongdeungpo-gu Is Seoul's Han River K-Drama District
paragraphs: When a K-Drama needs a character to stare at the river at night, cross a bridge after a breakup or walk into a glass tower for a high-stakes meeting, the location team very often ends up in Yeongdeungpo-gu. The district covers Yeouido, the flat island in the Han River that holds Korea's National Assembly, its main broadcasters and its financial district, plus older neighborhoods to the south such as Mullae-dong and Yeongdeungpo station.

In the public filming-location dataset published by the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Yeongdeungpo-gu has 582 records. Of those, 480 come from TV dramas, 77 from variety and food shows, 21 from K-Pop artists and four from films. By place type, 358 are parks, bridges and public spaces, 137 are restaurants and 61 are hotels. In other words, this is a district for walking along the water and looking up at skylines rather than a cafe-hopping district.

The single most filmed place in the whole district is Seogang Bridge, with 87 records. Two other Han River bridges, Wonhyo Bridge with 40 and Mapo Bridge with 16, are also near the top, and Yeouido Hangang Park adds another 36. Few districts in Korea can match that concentration of river scenes.

sections.heading: The Han River Bridges: Seogang, Wonhyo and Mapo
paragraphs: Seogang Bridge links the west end of Yeouido to Mapo-gu, and its red arch is easy to spot from the riverbank. According to the KCISA records, Choi Ung and Guk Yeon-su from Our Beloved Summer cross it on a date in episode 13, and Lee Sung-yeon from What's Wrong with Secretary Kim calls his parents here in episode 3 right after arriving back in Korea. The list also includes Designated Survivor: 60 Days, VIP, Winter Sonata and My Roommate Is a Gumiho.

The pedestrian walkway is open around the clock and free. The easiest way to see the bridge is from the riverside path in Yeouido Hangang Park at sunset, then walk onto the deck if you want the classic crossing shot.

Mapo Bridge sits at the east side of the park and appears in Hotel del Luna, where IU's character checks a gold bar, and in Uncontrollably Fond, where Kim Woo-bin's character tells Lim Ju-eun to stay away from him in episode 17. The dataset also lists PSY's Gentleman music video for the fountain scene. Wonhyo Bridge, a little further east, has 40 records including Misaeng, She Was Pretty and While You Were Sleeping.

sections.heading: Yeouido Hangang Park and Yeouido Park
paragraphs: This riverside park at 서울특별시 영등포구 여의동로 290 is where Seoul comes to picnic, ride rental bikes and order fried chicken delivered to the grass. In My Love from the Star episode 4, Do Min-joon cycles past the area near the Yeouido 119 rescue station. In More Than Friends episode 15, three best friends spend the night at the park's multi-plaza, and in Chief Kim episode 18, Kim Sung-ryong meets Seo Yul just after his release from prison. Get off at Yeouinaru Station on Line 5 and you are at the water in two minutes.

Yeouido Park is the long green strip in the middle of the island, between the office towers. It has 22 records. Be Melodramatic fans know it well: in episode 11, Son Beom-soo confesses to Im Jin-joo here, and in episode 12 she proposes they start dating and kisses him. The dataset also lists A Gentleman's Dignity and Record of Youth, plus K-Pop content from Lovelyz, OH MY GIRL and INFINITE. The park is open 24 hours, and Yeouido Station on Lines 5 and 9 is right at its edge.

sections.heading: Saetgang Bridge, the National Assembly and Parc1
paragraphs: Saetgang Bridge (샛강다리), at 서울특별시 영등포구 여의도동 39, is a curved footbridge over the small Saetgang stream that runs along the south side of Yeouido. It has a quiet, slightly melancholy feel that suits the dramas filmed here. The dataset says the three Park brothers in My Mister share a drink at a tent bar at the foot of the bridge, Chae Young-shin and Seo Jung-hoo go on a fake date here in Healer episode 11, and two characters walk along it at night in Shooting Stars episode 15.

At the west end of the island, the domed National Assembly building (국회의사당, 서울특별시 영등포구 의사당대로 1) is the explosion site in episode 1 of Designated Survivor: 60 Days and the workplace of Lee Jung-jae's character in Chief of Staff. Signal and My Liberation Notes also filmed here. You can photograph the building from the lawns outside the gate.

In the financial district, Parc1 (파크원, 서울특별시 영등포구 여의대로 108) appears in Extraordinary Attorney Woo episode 2 and in The Penthouse. Its basement connects to The Hyundai Seoul department store, where the dataset lists LSR X STILL BOOKS on B2 as a shop BLACKPINK's Jisoo shared on Instagram.

sections.heading: Seonyudo Park and the Mullae Art Village
paragraphs: Seonyudo Park, at 서울특별시 영등포구 선유로 343, is a former water treatment plant turned into a garden on a small island west of Yeouido. Its concrete tanks covered in vines make it one of the most photogenic parks in Seoul. In Boys Over Flowers episode 21, Geum Jan-di and Yoon Ji-hoo enter a couples photo contest here, and in Princess Hours episode 14, Crown Princess Shin Chae-kyung comes here alone and gives a balloon to a boy who recognizes her. VIXX also shot a self-made calendar here. The park is open from 6 AM to midnight; walk about ten minutes from Seonyudo Station on Line 9.

South of Yeouido, Mullae-dong is a neighborhood of small metal workshops that now share their alleys with artists' studios, wine bars and cafes. The dataset lists the area at 서울특별시 영등포구 도림로128가길 13-8 as the spot where Won Bin's character calls Kim Sae-ron out in the film The Man from Nowhere, and where Jay Park shot his GANG remix music video. Come in the late afternoon when the workshops close their shutters and the bars open. Mullae Station on Line 2 is the closest stop.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: Drama-Famous Yeongdeungpo Restaurants
paragraphs: Unsan (운산, 서울특별시 영등포구 여의공원로 101) is the hardest-working restaurant in the dataset for this district, with 26 drama records. Characters from Crash Landing on You, Itaewon Class, SKY Castle, My Mister, What's Wrong with Secretary Kim and Extraordinary Attorney Woo all have business lunches or family dinners here. It is open daily from 11:30 AM to 10 PM.

For a casual meal, Sambo Cheonggukjang (삼보 청국장, 서울특별시 영등포구 여의나루로 42 여의도종합상가 1층) is a fermented soybean stew restaurant the dataset says BTS's Jin visited, open daily 10 AM to 11 PM. In the evening, Yeouido Ua (여의도 우아, 서울특별시 영등포구 여의나루로 42) is the after-work pub from Because This Is My First Life episode 1, Law School episode 16 and Again My Life episode 5, open Monday to Saturday from 5 PM to midnight. Always confirm current hours on Naver Map before you go, since some places may have changed since the data was recorded.

sections.heading: Half-Day and One-Day Yeongdeungpo K-Spot Routes
paragraphs: Start at Yeouido Station and walk through Yeouido Park, then have lunch at Unsan or Sambo Cheonggukjang. Continue to Parc1 and The Hyundai Seoul, then walk north to Yeouido Hangang Park for the late afternoon. Finish with sunset views of Seogang Bridge and Mapo Bridge from the riverside path.

Begin at Seonyudo Park in the morning when the gardens are quiet, take Line 9 to National Assembly Station to see the dome, and spend the middle of the day on Yeouido. Stop at Saetgang Bridge on the way south, then end the day in Mullae Creative Village for dinner and drinks among the workshop alleys.
Show your taxi driver the Korean address for each stop; all of them are within a 15 to 20 minute ride of each other. Many of the riverside spots look best after dark, so leave the bridges for last.

sections.heading: Why Jung-gu Is Seoul's Best K-Drama Walking District
paragraphs: Jung-gu is the old commercial heart of Seoul, squeezed between the palaces of Jongno to the north and Namsan Mountain to the south. It is small, flat in most places and extremely well connected, which is exactly why location managers love it. In the public filming-location dataset published by the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Jung-gu has 601 records.

The mix tells you what kind of trip this is. Of those 601 records, 388 come from TV dramas, 146 from variety and food shows, 56 from K-Pop artists and 11 from films. By place type, 323 are streets, parks and public spaces, while 197 are restaurants. In other words, Jung-gu is less about sitting in an idol's favorite cafe and more about walking the same streets and stairways the characters walked.

The drama list is long and covers almost every era of K-Drama: Goblin, My Love from the Star, Misaeng, Extraordinary Attorney Woo, Vincenzo, Fight for My Way, My Mister, Twenty-Five Twenty-One and True Beauty. Among music entries BTS leads with seven records, followed by BLACKPINK with five. Films include 1987, The Priests, Assassination, The Handmaiden and Veteran. Namsan Tower and the Samsoon stairs are also in Jung-gu, but we covered them in our Itaewon and Namsan guide, so this article stays in the flat downtown.

sections.heading: Deoksugung Stonewall Road and Jeong-dong
paragraphs: If you only have one hour, spend it on Deoksugung Stonewall Road (덕수궁 돌담길), the lane that follows the curved stone wall of Deoksugung Palace from City Hall toward Jeong-dong. It is the single most filmed spot in central Jung-gu after the State Tower Namsan office building, with 29 records in the dataset.

The KCISA records list Goblin, Misaeng, My Love from the Star, Extraordinary Attorney Woo, My Liberation Notes, Brahms, Run On, The Lovers of Prague and Personal Taste, plus a BTS entry. In Personal Taste, Lee Min-ho's character carries a tipsy Son Ye-jin home along the wall in episode 3,, and in My Unfamiliar Family two characters revisit the lane in episode 10 to relive their autumn memories from their twenties. It is open all day, every day, and is at its best from late October to mid-November when the ginkgo trees turn gold.

Follow the wall west and it becomes Jeongdong-gil (정동길), which the dataset ties to My Liberation Notes and the film Sunny. Along the way you pass the Seoul Museum of Art (서울시립미술관, 덕수궁길 61), used in Goong (Princess Hours), and the small cafe Le Pool (르풀, 정동길 33), which appears in the dramas Alone With You and Liar Game. Deoksugung Palace itself charges a small entrance fee and closes on Mondays.

sections.heading: Myeongdong: The Cathedral from 1987 and The Priests
paragraphs: From City Hall it is a ten-minute walk east to Myeongdong. Most visitors come for skincare shops and street food, but the hill at the top of the shopping street holds Myeongdong Cathedral (명동대성당, 명동길 74), Korea's first Gothic-style brick church.

The dataset records the cathedral in the film 1987, where it is the place a priest reads out the statement that helped spark the June Democratic Struggle, and in The Priests, where Gang Dong-won's character comes to collect holy relics. The drama Black Knight also filmed here. The cathedral is an active church, so keep voices low and avoid photographing people during mass.

The main Myeongdong shopping street (명동길) appears in True Beauty, Dalja's Spring, She Would Never Know and At a Distance, Spring Is Green, where Bae In-hyuk's character works a part-time job at the crossroads in episode 1. The small MOS Burger on Myeongdong 9-gil (명동9길 37) is where An Eun-jin's character works in More Than Friends, also listed in the dataset with a Lovelyz entry.

sections.heading: Seoul Station, Seoullo 7017 and Yakhyeon Church
paragraphs: Ride one stop from City Hall to Seoul Station and you reach three more strong spots within a short walk of each other.

Seoullo 7017 (서울로7017, 청파로 432) is a former highway overpass turned into an elevated garden walkway. The dataset lists Vincenzo, Fight for My Way, Police University, Little Women, Inspector Koo and Live Up to Your Name, where Kim Nam-gil's Joseon doctor lands in 2017 Seoul on this very bridge. In Police University episode 7, Jung Soo-jung and Jin Young sit in the garden to talk after a court hearing.

At the far end of Seoullo, down the stairs toward Jungnim-dong, stands Yakhyeon Catholic Church (중림동 약현성당, 청파로 447-1), the oldest Western-style church building in Korea. It has 27 records, more than the Myeongdong Cathedral, including My Girlfriend Is a Gumiho, where Lee Seung-gi finally confesses to Shin Min-ah in front of the church in episode 11, as well as Her Private Life, The K2, Black Knight, The Fiery Priest, Penthouse 3, Dear My Friends and Iris.

Back beside the station, Culture Station Seoul 284 (문화역서울284, 통일로 1), the restored 1925 station building, appears in Assassination, The Handmaiden, Stairway to Heaven and Inspector Koo. It is now an exhibition space, open Tuesday to Sunday.

sections.heading: Euljiro and Dongdaemun Design Plaza
paragraphs: Euljiro is Seoul's old printing and lighting district, now packed with retro bars and hidden cafes. The dataset ties Daelim Sangga (대림상가, 을지로 157) to Stranger and True Beauty, and the Cheonggye Sangga arcade (청계천로 160) to Vincenzo and Move to Heaven. Paro Grand (파로그랜드, 을지로5길 26), a restaurant near Euljiro, shows up in ten dramas including My Love from the Star, SKY Castle, 18 Again and Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo.

The curved silver Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP, 을지로 281) is listed under its operator, the Seoul Design Foundation, with 12 dramas. Black Sun uses it for a meeting that ends in a shooting in episode 5, Are You Human? stages a self-driving car launch here in episode 3, and Vincenzo, The Devil Judge, Melancholia, Love Alarm and Producer all film around its plazas. The buildings are open daily from 10:00 to 20:00 and the LED rose garden and outdoor walkways are free.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: Idol-Approved Jung-gu Restaurants
paragraphs: Jung-gu's 197 restaurant records are dominated by food shows such as Delicious Guys, Baek Jong-won's Top 3 Chef King and Wednesday Food Talk, so you can eat well almost anywhere. For K-Pop fans the clear pick is Geumdwaeji Sikdang (금돼지식당, 다산로 149) near Yaksu Station, a pork-belly restaurant that the dataset links to BTS, TWICE, SHINee, TVXQ, Dynamic Duo and Davichi. It opens daily from 11:30 to 22:00, and queues are long at dinner, so arrive close to opening.

For a quieter coffee, the cafe Uioeui Johap (의외의조합, 동호로17길 121) was used as Kim Mi-so's home in What's Wrong with Secretary Kim and also appears in Nevertheless and Was It Love?. It opens from 12:00 to 18:00.

sections.heading: Half-Day and One-Day Jung-gu K-Spot Routes
paragraphs: For a half day, start at City Hall Station Exit 2, walk Deoksugung Stonewall Road and Jeongdong-gil, then cross to Myeongdong Cathedral and finish with street food on the Myeongdong shopping street. This loop is about 3 kilometers and needs no transport.

For a full day, add Seoul Station in the morning: walk Seoullo 7017 to Yakhyeon Church, come back past Culture Station Seoul 284, then take Line 1 or Line 2 to City Hall for the stone-wall walk and Myeongdong. In the evening, ride Line 2 or Line 4 to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station to see DDP lit up, and finish with a late pork-belly dinner at Geumdwaeji Sikdang, one stop away on Line 6 at Yaksu.

Every spot here is on the subway, so a T-money card is all you need. Show the Korean address on your phone to a taxi driver if you get tired, since most rides inside Jung-gu are short. Churches and Deoksugung Palace keep their own hours, and Culture Station Seoul 284 closes on Mondays, so the best day to do this route is Tuesday through Saturday. Myeongdong and Seoul Station also have many mid-range hotels, which makes Jung-gu a convenient base for the rest of your Korea trip.

sections.heading: Why Gangnam-gu Is Seoul's K-Pop Dining District
paragraphs: If Jongno is where Korean dramas go for palaces and Mapo-gu is where they go for youth, Gangnam-gu is where they go for glamour. In the public filming-location dataset published by the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Gangnam-gu has 995 records, the third-highest count of any district in Korea after Jongno-gu and Mapo-gu.

The mix is very different from the old city. Of those 995 records, 584 are restaurants and 93 are cafes, while 229 are streets, shops and public spaces. Gangnam is where idols go out to eat, where agencies and broadcasters film variety segments, and where drama writers send their rich heirs and CEOs for dinner.

Among music entries, BLACKPINK (29 records), Super Junior (26) and BTS (25) lead the dataset here, followed by TVXQ, SEVENTEEN and TWICE. On the drama side the records include Crash Landing on You, Goblin, What's Wrong with Secretary Kim, My Love from the Star, My Mister, Itaewon Class and Twenty-Five Twenty-One. Variety shows such as Omniscient Interfering View also filmed dozens of restaurant segments in the district.

sections.heading: Cheongdam: The Crash Landing on You and Goblin Block
paragraphs: The most rewarding single street for drama fans is Seolleung-ro 152-gil in Cheongdam-dong. At number 21 is Wolfgang's Steakhouse, which the KCISA record says appears in episode 1 of Crash Landing on You as the restaurant where Yoon Se-ri (Son Ye-jin) has dinner with her boyfriend Cha Sang-woo, and where the paparazzi photo of the couple is taken. The same restaurant is also listed for BLACKPINK, with Jisoo and Lisa posting visits on Instagram, and for NCT's Taeyong.

A few doors down at number 30 is Space Cheongdam, which the dataset lists as the lounge bar from episode 12 of Goblin where Yoo Deok-hwa (Yook Sung-jae) meets Kim Shin (Gong Yoo) and the Grim Reaper (Lee Dong-wook). The same address also appears as a filming spot for an episode of Run BTS.
To finish the Crash Landing on You trail, head to Cheongdam Station on Line 7. In episode 12, Geum Eun-dong waits for Ri Jeong-hyeok (Hyun Bin) at Exit 3, according to the dataset.

sections.heading: Apgujeong Rodeo & K-Star Road: BLACKPINK's Favorite Streets
paragraphs: Apgujeong-ro, the long avenue that runs through Apgujeong and Cheongdam, is packed with BLACKPINK entries. The dataset lists Louis Vuitton Maison Seoul (압구정로 454) as a cafe Rosé visited, the House of Dior Seoul (압구정로 464) as a place Lisa and Jisoo visited together in Lisa's YouTube video, and 10 Corso Como Cheongdam (압구정로 416) as a cafe Jennie posted on Instagram.
Right by Apgujeong Rodeo Station is K-Star Road (압구정로 339-3), a street lined with large art-toy figures of Hallyu stars. It is free, outdoors and one of the easiest photo stops in the district.

Fans of What's Wrong with Secretary Kim can look for the Sulwhasoo Dosan flagship (도산대로45길 18), which Kim Mi-so and Lee Young-joon walk past on their way to lunch, and RAUM (언주로 564), listed as the party venue from episode 1. Itaewon Class fans can find Queens Park Cheongdam (압구정로60길 22), which the dataset says plays Oh Soo-ah's restaurant in the drama.

sections.heading: Sinsa & Nonhyeon: Where BTS Trained and Ate
paragraphs: For ARMY, the area between Sinsa and Nonhyeon is the heart of the district. The dataset lists Hakdong Park (강남대로140길 47) as a spot from BTS's trainee days that also appeared in Rookie King, and Yoojung Sikdang (도산대로28길 14) as the members' regular restaurant when they were trainees.

Other records include Eunhaenggol Sinsa (강남대로152길 42), a sushi restaurant visited by Jimin and V that is also listed for BLACKPINK's Jisoo, and Uga (도산대로49길 22), where BTS held a dinner live stream after a Billboard award promise, which Jisoo is also recorded as visiting.
SEVENTEEN fans have their own stops nearby, including Aloha Poke Hakdong (논현로131길 24), posted on the group's official Instagram.

sections.heading: COEX and Gangnam Station
paragraphs: On the eastern side of the district, COEX (영동대로 513) is listed for Business Proposal, where Shin Ha-ri meets Kang Tae-moo at the hotel's sky lounge restaurant. Next door, Starfield COEX Mall (봉은사로 524) appears in the dataset as the filming spot for the performance-team version of SEVENTEEN's Adore U dance video. COEX is a good rainy-day stop, and it is reached from Samseong Station on Line 2 or Bongeunsa Station on Line 9.

Finally, Gangnam Station itself (강남대로 396) is in the dataset for My Love from the Star. In episode 5, Do Min-joon (Kim Soo-hyun) rides past a station exit on a bicycle as Cheon Song-yi's billboard is taken down.

sections.heading: A One-Day Gangnam K-Spot Route and Practical Tips
paragraphs: A comfortable order is Sinsa and Hakdong in the morning, Apgujeong Rodeo and K-Star Road around lunch, Cheongdam's Seolleung-ro 152-gil in the afternoon, and COEX for the evening. The Suin-Bundang Line, Line 7 and Line 2 connect these areas, and taxis are easy to find.

Many of these places are working restaurants and cafes, and some are fine-dining spots that need reservations, so check opening hours and booking rules before you go. Addresses here come from the KCISA public dataset and businesses can move or close, so it is worth confirming on Naver Map or KakaoMap on the day. Please be respectful at private shops and do not block entrances for photos.

sections.heading: Why Mapo-gu Is Seoul's K-Pop and Youth Drama Neighborhood
paragraphs: If Jongno is where Korean dramas go for palaces and hanok, Mapo-gu is where they go for youth. In the public filming-location dataset published by the Korea Culture Information Service Agency (KCISA), Mapo-gu has 1,025 records, the second-highest count of any district in Korea after Jongno-gu. The mix is telling: roughly 400 of those records are streets and public spaces, about 400 are restaurants, and another 160 are cafes. In other words, this is a neighborhood where people eat, drink coffee, and wander, and that is exactly what the cameras capture.

The district stretches from the student streets around Hongik University (Hongdae) and the indie cafes of Yeonnam-dong and Sangsu, down to the Han River at Mangwon, and west to the broadcasting towers of Sangam Digital Media City, where MBC, SBS and other networks have offices. That geography explains the mix of entries: idol vlog cafes in Hongdae, romance-drama dates in Yeonnam, and broadcast-variety restaurant shoots around Sangam.

Among music and idol entries, BLACKPINK (18 records) and BTS (7 records) lead the dataset here, alongside WINNER and OH MY GIRL. On the drama side, the most frequent titles include Because This Is My First Life, My Roommate Is a Gumiho, Nevertheless, What's Wrong with Secretary Kim, Lovestruck in the City, Her Private Life, and Something in the Rain. Food variety shows such as Wednesday Food Talk and Delicious Guys account for many of the restaurant records, which makes Mapo an easy place to eat well while location hunting.

sections.heading: Hongdae and Sangsu: BTS and BLACKPINK Spots
paragraphs: The dataset lists the mural alley at 독막로19길 42 as a jacket-photo location for BTS's LOVE YOURSELF era. The surrounding lanes between Sangsu Station and Hongdae's main streets are packed with graffiti walls that change over time, so the exact mural may look different when you visit. Go before 11 AM for clean shots without crowds.

BLACKPINK has more Mapo-gu entries than any other act. Entries include Insol Coffee in Sangsu (인솔커피 상수점, 독막로18길 16), recorded as the cafe Rosé visited with her dog Hank, and Mon Cafe Gregory (양화로6길 84), which the dataset notes Jisoo praised on Instagram. These are working businesses, so buy a drink, keep photos quick, and check Naver Map for current hours before you go.

The eyewear flagship at 독막로7길 54 appears in Something in the Rain, where Yoon Jin-ah (Son Ye-jin) comes here with coworkers during a lunch break in Episode 12. The store's rotating art installations make it worth a stop even if you are not shopping.

sections.heading: Yeonnam-dong and the Gyeongui Line Forest Park: Romance Drama Walk
paragraphs: Yeonnam-dong is the most relaxed part of this route. A disused railway line was turned into the Gyeongui Line Forest Park, a long, narrow strip of lawn and trees that locals nicknamed "Yeontral Park." According to the dataset, Ryan Gold (Kim Jae-wook) and Sung Duk-mi (Park Min-young) come to a corner of this park on a date in the final episode of Her Private Life (연남로 80).

Two cafes from Our Beloved Summer sit within a short walk of each other on the north side of Yeonnam. Cafe Scone (성미산로 172, 2nd floor) is where Kim Ji-woong (Kim Sung-cheol) tries to persuade Kook Yeon-su (Kim Da-mi) to appear in his documentary, and Mirabeau Patisserie (성미산로29길 35-6) is where Yeon-su's blind date falls apart. The same lanes also appear in More Than Friends, when Kyung Woo-yeon (Shin Ye-eun) and Lee Soo (Ong Seong-wu) explore Yeonnam on foot along 동교로46길.

Just south of Hongik University Station, the book-themed stretch of the old rail line at 와우산로37길 35 is listed as a main backdrop for Welcome to Waikiki. It is free, quiet in the morning, and lined with small bookshops and benches.

In Seogyo-dong, the former residence of President Choi Kyu-hah (동교로15길 10) is recorded as the exterior used for Dong-ryong's house in Reply 1988. It is a heritage house rather than a set, so check opening days on Naver Map before you go.

sections.heading: Mangwon and Sangam: Han River, Sky Park and Broadcast Town
paragraphs: Mangwon Hangang Park (마포나루길 467) appears in Ex-Girlfriend Club, where the area near Seongsan Bridge is a regular meeting spot for the leads. Grab snacks at Mangwon Market first, then walk about 15 minutes to the river for a picnic or a rented bike.

Haneul Park (하늘공원로 95) sits on a former landfill turned into a hilltop grassland. In Go Back Couple Episode 4, Min Seo-young (Go Bo-gyeol) and Choi Ban-do (Son Ho-jun) come here on a date. In October and November the silver grass (eulalia) turns gold, which makes this one of the best autumn photo spots in Seoul. The adjoining World Cup Park (하늘공원로 86) is where the siblings talk things through in Episode 12 of My Unfamiliar Family, and the Peace Park (월드컵로 243-60) is listed as a park RM posted on Twitter.

Five former oil storage tanks were converted into the Oil Tank Culture Park (문화비축기지, 증산로 87). Park Jae-won (Ji Chang-wook) comes here to take photos in Episode 3 of Lovestruck in the City. The concrete-and-steel tanks make a striking contrast with the leafy parks next door.

sections.heading: Where to Eat: Drama Restaurants and Local Favorites
paragraphs: Mapo's restaurant entries lean toward Korean barbecue and casual drinking spots, which is a good match for the dramas they appear in. Mapo Sogeumgui (마포소금구이, 와우산로32길 32) is listed as the pub that Park Sae-ro-yi and his father prepare in Itaewon Class. Seoul Dwaeji-gui (서울돼지구이, 와우산로 15-3) is where Jeon Yeo-been and Son Suk-ku drink soju over grilled pork in Be Melodramatic.

For something lighter, Mangwon Market is famous among locals for cheap street snacks such as fried chicken pieces, croquettes, and hotteok. Yeonnam-dong's side streets are packed with small brunch cafes and bakeries. Because these records come from a public dataset compiled over several years, some businesses may have moved or closed, so always confirm on Naver Map or KakaoMap before making a special trip.

sections.heading: Getting Around Mapo-gu: Subway, Taxi and a Half-Day Route
paragraphs: Hongik University Station (Line 2, AREX Airport Railroad, and Gyeongui-Jungang Line) is the main hub and has a direct train from Incheon Airport. Sangsu and Hapjeong (Line 6, Hapjeong also on Line 2) are best for the mural streets and Sangsu cafes, Mangwon (Line 6) for the market and river, and World Cup Stadium (Line 6) for Haneul Park and the Oil Tank Culture Park.

Copy the Korean addresses in this guide into Kakao T or show them to the driver. Korean road addresses are far more reliable than English place names, and Google Maps walking directions are limited in Korea, so use Naver Map or KakaoMap for navigation.

Start at 10 AM at Hongik University Station Exit 3 and walk the Gyeongui Line Forest Park north into Yeonnam-dong for the Our Beloved Summer cafes. Around noon, head south through Hongdae to the mural streets and Gentle Monster, then have lunch near Sangsu. Take Line 6 three stops to Mangwon for the market and the river, or continue two more stops to World Cup Stadium for a late-afternoon walk up Haneul Park, timed for sunset in autumn.

title: Jongno & Bukchon, Seoul: Complete K-Drama Palace & Hanok Filming Guide (Goblin, Lovely Runner, Queen of Tears)
subtitle: Walk through 600 years of Joseon royal architecture and atmospheric stone-wall alleys featured in Goblin, Kingdom, Lovely Runner, and Mr. Sunshine.
summary: Discover how to explore Seoul's historic heart like a K-Drama location scout—from Deoksugung Stone Wall Road and Bukchon Hanok Village to Anguk's hidden courtyard cafes, subway exits, and Hanbok photo tips.

sections.heading: Why Jongno & Bukchon Are the Beating Heart of K-Drama Cinematography
paragraphs: No district in South Korea appears on global streaming screens more frequently than Jongno-gu and neighboring Jung-gu in central Seoul. Verified records from the Korea Cultural Information Service Agency (KCISA) public filming dataset show hundreds of drama, film, and music video productions clustering around Gyeongbokgung Palace, Changdeokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village, Seochon, and Deoksugung Stone Wall Road.

For international travelers, what makes Jongno extraordinary is its walkable density. Within a single two-kilometer radius, you can stand on the ginkgo-lined stone path where Kim Shin first passed Ji Eun-tak under a rain umbrella in Goblin (Guardian: The Lonely and Great God), climb the curved traditional tiled-roof ridge of Bukchon Hanok Village overlooking modern Seoul towers, and step into the nostalgic neighborhood alleys of Seochon and Ikseon-dong.

sections.heading: Key Verified Filming Locations in This District (With Exact Korean Addresses)
paragraphs: 1. Deoksugung Stone Wall Road (덕수궁 돌담길 — 99 Sejong-daero, Jung-gu, Seoul): Running along the outer wall of Deoksugung Palace from City Hall Station (Subway Line 1 & 2, Exit 1 or 2), this 900-meter pedestrian lane is legendary in Goblin, Do You Like Brahms?, and Lovely Runner. Visit between 8:00 AM and 9:30 AM for soft morning light filtering through the trees, or during late October and November when golden ginkgo leaves carpet the cobblestones.

2. Bukchon Hanok Village Photo Point #6 (북촌한옥마을 — 37 Gyedong-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul): Reached via Anguk Station (Line 3, Exit 2), this uphill residential lane preserves authentic Joseon-era aristocratic homes (hanok). Stand at the top of the slope looking south to capture dark curved clay roofs framing Namsan Seoul Tower in the distance. Remember that Bukchon is an active residential neighborhood with designated visitor hours (10:00 AM–5:00 PM) and quiet-zone etiquette.

3. Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hyangwonjeong Pavilion (경복궁 — 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul): Accessed directly from Gyeongbokgung Station (Line 3, Exit 5), the royal throne hall (Geunjeongjeon) and water pavilions have anchored Kingdom, The Red Sleeve, Under the Queen's Umbrella, and BTS's iconic 'IDOL' & 'Mikrokosmos' performances on The Tonight Show.

sections.heading: Half-Day Walking Itinerary & Subway Navigation Strategy
paragraphs: Start at Gyeongbokgung Station (Exit 4) at 9:00 AM when palace gates open. Wearing a rented traditional Hanbok grants you free admission to all major royal palaces in Seoul. Spend 90 minutes photographing Geunjeongjeon Hall and Gyeonghoeru Pavilion before exiting via the east gate toward Bukchon Hanok Village.

From Bukchon, stroll downhill into Ikseon-dong Hanok Alley (익선동 한옥거리) for lunch—where early-1920s courtyard houses have been transformed into sunlit soufflé pancake cafes, salt-bread bakeries, and craft tea houses featured in Hotel Del Luna and Queen of Tears. Finish your afternoon with a 15-minute walk along Cheonggyecheon Stream to Deoksugung Stone Wall Road at golden hour.

sections.heading: Where to Eat, Stay & Book Local Passes in Jongno
paragraphs: Local Culinary Highlights: Don't miss Tosokchon Samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup inside a grand hanok near Gyeongbokgung), Hwangsaengga Kalguksu (Michelin Bib Gourmand hand-cut noodle soup and giant steamed dumplings in Bukchon), and Onion Anguk for pastries under a traditional wooden roof.

Where to Stay: Choosing a hotel in Insadong, Myeongdong, or Gwanghwamun puts you within walking distance of all four royal palaces and direct Airport Railroad / Limousine Bus connections to Incheon International Airport (ICN).

title: Suwon Hwaseong & Haenggung-dong: Why Korea's UNESCO Fortress City Is the #1 K-Drama Filming Neighborhood
subtitle: From Sol and Sun-jae's iconic blue-and-yellow gate houses in Lovely Runner to Our Beloved Summer and Extraordinary Attorney Woo.
summary: Just 35 minutes south of Seoul Station by KTX or Subway Line 1, Suwon's Haenggung-dong mural alleys and UNESCO Hwaseong Fortress walls host Korea's highest concentration of youth romance K-Drama scenes.

sections.heading: How Haenggung-dong Became Korea's Capital of Youth & Romance K-Dramas
paragraphs: If you have watched Lovely Runner (선재 업고 튀어), Our Beloved Summer (그해 우리는), Extraordinary Attorney Woo (이상한 변호사 우영우), or Itaewon Class, you have already fallen in love with Haenggung-dong in Suwon. Located directly inside the 5.7-kilometer stone ramparts of the UNESCO World Heritage Hwaseong Fortress, this low-rise neighborhood bans high-rise apartment towers to preserve historic sightlines.

Because the streets retain warm brick houses, flowering wall vines, stone bridges over the Suwoncheon Stream, and panoramic sunset fortress gates, Korean television directors repeatedly choose Haenggung-dong to portray nostalgic high school and university neighborhoods.

sections.heading: Must-Visit Verified Filming Spots in Suwon (Step-by-Step Route)
paragraphs: 1. Im Sol & Ryu Sun-jae's Houses (화성행궁 행리단길 몽테드 — 14 Hwaseomun-ro 48beon-gil, Paldal-gu, Suwon): The viral yellowumbrella corner where Im Sol runs out to meet Ryu Sun-jae in Lovely Runner sits right in the heart of Haengnidan-gil. The two houses face each other across a charming narrow lane, just a 4-minute walk from Hwaseomun Gate.

2. Choi Ung's House & Jangangiun Fortress Wall Path (장안공원 성곽길 — 293 Jeongjo-ro, Paldal-gu, Suwon): Just north of Hwaseomun Gate, the curving stone fortress wall and rooftop terrace served as illustrator Choi Ung's home in Our Beloved Summer. Walking the outer fortress trail during sunset gives you golden light across both ancient battlements and neighborhood rooftops.

3. Woo Young-woo Gimbap Shop (우영우 김밥집 / 카자구루마 — 61 Sinpung-ro 23beon-gil, Paldal-gu, Suwon): Situated along the same walkable Haengnidan-gil cafe street, the exterior of Young-woo's father's gimbap diner is an active Japanese fusion restaurant where fans stop for photos.

sections.heading: How to Get to Suwon from Seoul & Local Food Specialties
paragraphs: Fastest Transit from Seoul: Board a KTX, ITX-Saemaeul, or Mugunghwa train from Seoul Station or Yongsan Station to Suwon Station (25–32 minutes), or take Seoul Subway Line 1 / Bundang Line directly to Suwon Station. From Suwon Station Exit 4, hop on local bus #11, #13, or a 10-minute taxi ride straight to Hwaseong Haenggung Temporary Palace (화성행궁).

Suwon's Famous Dish — Suwon Wang-Galbi (Marinated Beef Short Ribs): Since the 1940s, Suwon has been famous across Korea for giant charcoal-grilled beef short ribs seasoned with sesame oil, garlic, and Korean pear, alongside Suwon 통닭거리 (Suwon Fried Chicken Street) right by Paldalmun Gate where Extreme Job was inspired.

title: Gangneung & Jumunjin East Coast Guide: From the Iconic Goblin Breakwater to BTS Bus Stop & Anmok Coffee Street
subtitle: Plan the ultimate 1-day KTX East Sea pilgrimage across Gangwon Province's turquoise beaches, buckwheat fields, and oceanfront roasteries.
summary: Only 1 hour and 50 minutes from Seoul Station on the KTX-Eum high-speed train, Gangneung's Jumunjin coastline combines the Goblin red-scarf breakwater and BTS's 'You Never Walk Alone' album cover bus stop.

sections.heading: Why Gangneung Is Korea's #1 Coastal Pilgrimage for K-Drama & K-Pop Fans
paragraphs: Stretching along the crystal-clear East Sea in Gangwon Province, Gangneung (강릉) offers a dramatic coastal contrast to Seoul's neon skyline. Thanks to the KTX Gangneung Line built for the 2018 Winter Olympics, travelers can board a high-speed train at Seoul Station or Cheongnyangni Station in the morning and stand beside crashing turquoise waves under two hours later.

Two of the most photographed pop-culture landmarks in modern Korean history sit just 3.5 kilometers apart along the northern Jumunjin shoreline: the stone breakwater where Ji Eun-tak first summoned Kim Shin by blowing out a birthday candle in Goblin (Guardian), and the pastel oceanfront bus stop reproduced for BTS's 'You Never Walk Alone' ('Spring Day') album jacket.

sections.heading: Exact Coordinates & Photography Tips Along Jumunjin Coast
paragraphs: 1. Jumunjin Breakwater — Goblin Red Scarf Pier (주문진 방사제 — 1609 Haean-ro, Jumunjin-eup, Gangneung-si): Unlike the northern fishery harbor breakwater, the exact filming jetty is opposite café street at Yeongjin Beach / Jumunjin southern coastal road. Nearby cafés rent red knit scarves and white buckwheat flower bouquets so you can recreate the exact framing from Episode 1.

2. BTS Bus Stop at Hyangho Beach (주문진 BTS 버스정류장 — 210-125 Hyangho-ri, Jumunjin-eup, Gangneung-si): Built at the exact spot on the sandy edge of Hyangho Beach where BTS photographed the 'You Never Walk Alone' jacket, this shelter looks directly out over the horizon of the East Sea. Arrive before 10:00 AM on weekdays for clear, queue-free photos.

3. Anmok Beach Coffee Street (안목해변 커피거리 — Changhae-ro 14beon-gil, Gangneung-si): After exploring Jumunjin in the morning, head south to Anmok Beach, where over 30 specialty coffee roasteries line the white-sand promenade with multi-story glass windows overlooking the waves.

sections.heading: Local Gangneung Delicacies & KTX Travel Tips
paragraphs: Must-Eat Dishes in Gangneung: Chodang Sundubu (초당순두부 — silky uncurdled tofu simmered with clean East Sea seawater, including spicy seafood jjamppong sundubu and black-sesame sundubu gelato), Jumunjin fresh snow crab & raw fish market, and Gangneung Jungang Market's crispy dakgangjeong (sweet-spicy glazed chicken).

Transportation Tip: Book your round-trip KTX tickets to Gangneung Station at least 1–2 weeks in advance if traveling on a Friday or weekend. From Gangneung KTX Station, Gangneung City sets up an official Tourist Taxi program (3-hour flat-rate private taxi) that covers Jumunjin Breakwater, BTS Bus Stop, Arte Museum, and Anmok Beach seamlessly.

title: Itaewon, Namsan & Yongsan: Walking Through Itaewon Class, HYBE K-Pop Landmarks & Seoul Skyline Filming Spots
subtitle: Follow Park Sae-royi's footsteps from Noksapyeong Overpass and Danbam rooftops up to Namsan Seoul Tower and Yongsan's K-Pop hub.
summary: Yongsan-gu connects Seoul's most famous panoramic observatory—Namsan Seoul Tower—with the hillside rooftop bars of Haebangchon, Itaewon Class pedestrian bridges, and the global headquarters of HYBE.

sections.heading: Why Yongsan & Namsan Deliver the Ultimate Seoul Panorama
paragraphs: Rising 243 meters at the geographical center of Seoul, Namsan Mountain and the surrounding neighborhoods of Yongsan-gu (Itaewon, Haebangchon, Gyeongnidan, and Hangangjin) create dramatic multi-level streetscapes. Steep hillside stairs, pedestrian overpasses framing Namsan Seoul Tower, and rooftop terraces overlooking the Han River make Yongsan a visual signature of modern K-Dramas.

In Itaewon Class, almost every pivotal turning point in Park Sae-royi's journey was filmed along the ridge connecting Noksapyeong Station, Haebangchon (HBC), and Huam-dong's Namsan Park Fortress Wall trail.

sections.heading: Top Verified Filming Spots in Yongsan-gu
paragraphs: 1. Noksapyeong Pedestrian Overpass (녹사평역 육교 — 195 Noksapyeong-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul): Step out of Noksapyeong Station (Subway Line 6, Exit 3) and walk 150 meters onto the steel pedestrian bridge. Looking north, the avenue curves uphill directly toward Namsan Seoul Tower—the exact frame where Park Sae-royi stands deep in thought throughout Itaewon Class.

2. Oriole & The Finest Rooftop Line in Haebangchon (해방촌 루프탑 거리 — Sinheung-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul): Climb the hillside road toward Namsan Sowol-gil to find the real-life rooftop pub buildings featured as the second Danbam location and finale kiss viewpoint.

3. Namsan Seoul Tower & Locks of Love Terrace (남산서울타워 — 105 Namsangongwon-gil, Yongsan-gu, Seoul): Featured in Boys Over Flowers, My Love from the Star, True Beauty, and Legend of the Blue Sea, the Namsan Cable Car and Namsan Observation Deck remain Seoul's #1 romantic landmark.

sections.heading: Combining Namsan with HYBE Insight Cafe District in Yongsan
paragraphs: Ten minutes southwest of Noksapyeong by subway or bus lies Hangang-daero near Sinyongsan Station (Line 4, Exit 2), home to the HYBE Headquarters building. The blocks behind HYBE are packed with fan-favorite specialty coffee shops, birthday event cafes, and traditional Korean barbecue restaurants frequented by K-Pop artists and choreographers.

Best Time to Visit: Start at Sinyongsan / HYBE in the early afternoon, ride Line 6 to Noksapyeong Overpass & Haebangchon around 4:30 PM for golden hour, and take the Namsan Circular Bus (#01A or #01B) up to Namsan Seoul Tower just as the city lights switch on.
